name: CheckSecBN
description: Narly/checksec-style PE mitigation report (ASLR, DEP, SafeSEH, GS, CFG, signing) for Binary Ninja.
longdescription: Adds a 'CheckSecBN > Show Mitigation Report' command that statically parses the loaded PE's headers and load-config directory to report exploit mitigation status: ASLR/Dynamic Base, High Entropy VA, DEP/NX, SafeSEH, GS (heuristic), Control Flow Guard, Force Integrity, AppContainer, and Authenticode signature presence. Inspired by the classic WinDbg 'narly' extension, but works statically against the binary Binary Ninja already has loaded. No debugger session required.
